purpose: first and only confirm read of the structural binding-copy task

frozen.copy_stop_rule: per-hop copy limit = name-field end from the record template delimiter + terminator; no sample-specific constant, no gamma, no generated weights

decision_rules: L1: every mechanical invariant must hit its target (1.0 or 0) and the confirm record template must be fixed-length, terminator-terminated and counterexample-free; any deviation -> structural_regression, with the failing byte position and record kind localised.
Milestone: confirm completion >= 0.95 -> milestone holds; the capability card upgrades 'binding copy + selection' with 'structural implementation, training-weight contribution 0'.
Overfit: confirm completion - dev completion <= -0.05 -> dev_overfit_of_structure, listing which design-split features were baked in (field lengths 12/6, template shapes style0/1/2, terminator).
Otherwise: milestone_not_met, report the gap and the failure positions.
Order: L1 first; a structural regression overrides every other branch.
immutability: written once before the confirm read; never rewritten afterwards
no_change_policy: 0 training, 0 optimizer steps, 0 Adam, no parameter or graph change, no tuning, no re-run after seeing confirm
